spans.s: ciraṃ with gen., it is long since …; ciraṃ me devanikāyaṃ śuddhāvāsaṃ (or śuddhā˚ deva˚) upasaṃkrāntasya Mv 〔i.56.7〕, and by plausible em. 〔i.35.1〕, it is long since I visited the Śu. class of gods.

ciratarakena, adv. (to compv. cira-tara plus -ka), in or after a longer time: yuṣmākaṃ evaṃ cira˚ vāro bhaviṣyati imehi duvehi potakehi jātehi Mv 〔i.362.3〕, the lot (of death) will fall on you after a longer time, if these two fawns are born. But mss. ciratanakena (em. Senart); possibly a deriv. of Skt. cirantana is intended.

cira-sthitika, adj. (= Pali ciraṭṭhitika; Skt. cira plus sthitika), long-enduring, lasting: gaṇavaro, the excellent assembly (of monks), Mv 〔i.301.1〕 (vs); kulavaṃśa, family line, Divy 〔2.14〕; 〔99.6〕; Av 〔i.14.15〕 etc.; 〔277.1〕; Karmav 〔59.15〕; brahmacarya, Mvy 〔3356〕; Divy 〔207.28〕; (sa āyuṣmān … evaṃdīrghāyur evaṃ-)cirasthitikaḥ Bbh 〔254.1〕, … lasting for such a long time; dharmavinaya, Bhīk 〔4a.3〕; saddharma, Mvy 〔6354〕; ˚ka-tā, state of being …, Bbh 〔28.20〕; saddharma-˚ka-tā, Bbh 〔210.11〕; 〔229.10〕; a-cirasthitika-tā, transitoriness (sarvasaṃskāragatasya), Dbh 〔31.4〕. See also s.v. sthitaka (4).
? cīra-cīra-cīvaraka, adj., tumbledown (?), of a house: MSV 〔i.82.11〕 = avacīra-vicīraka.
